name: HYDRA-UMC-WATCH
build: ./build.sh or build.bat (bumps version, runs JUnit tests, assembleDebug). Wear OS 3+ target.
notes: Functional v0: real differentiated haptic vibration patterns per alert severity, and a real kotlinx.serialization-backed SERVER<->WATCH sync-message protocol (parse/serialize, not the WebSocket transport itself). 12 JUnit tests. The real WebSocket connection, wireless E-STOP, and glanceable status dashboard remain future work.
